subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Avoid the puddles caused by the downpour was quite a problem while I was driving.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Avoid the puddles."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentences always begin with a **subject** and not with a **verb.**
 
• Here, **Avoid** is used which is a **verb**. The erroneous part **“Avoid the puddles”** should be **“ Avoiding the puddles”.**
 
• Here, **Avoiding** is a **gerund** that makes the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• **Therefore**, the correct answer is **option 1. ​**

**Correct Sentence: __*****__Avoiding the puddles__** caused by the downpour was quite a problem while I was driving.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**__Additional Information__**

__
 
• A **Gerund** is a non-finite__ **verb** that functions as a noun. It is formed by adding **‘ing’** with a verb. (verb**-ing**) A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence. The **gerund **always has the same function as a **noun.**

 
 
• **Example**: *Dancing is a good exercise.*
